source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
How it works now

\- USDC: Approve → auto-mint → success modal (only after mint).
\- ETH: Dynamic price calculation → sufficient buffer → successful swap.

The ETH price shown will fluctuate to match $15 USDC based on current market rates. The contract’s minETHForMint is 0.0055 ETH (~$16.50), so the frontend uses the higher of the dynamic price or this minimum.

Hard refresh your browser (Ctrl+Shift+R or Cmd+Shift+R) and try minting again.
Both USDC and ETH should work correctly.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
I’ve shipped fixes to stop false “Mint Successful” modals and to ensure approval -> mint flows run correctly. Deployed to production just now.

What changed:

\- Success modal gating: Only shows when the mint transaction receipt matches the current mint hash and hasn’t already been shown. Typing/deleting referral codes will no longer trigger the success popup.
\- Reset on new mint attempt: When you click mint, we clear prior success state, pending params, and tracking refs so stale success states can’t leak into the next attempt.
\- USDC auto-mint after approval: Removed the stale success guard so the mint runs right after approval completes (no more approval-only success).
\- ETH amount and buffer: Dynamic ETH pricing still uses the higher of live price vs contract min (0.0055 ETH), with buffer; unchanged from prior hotfix.

Please hard refresh (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R) and try again:
\- USDC: approve -> mint should fire automatically; success modal only after the mint tx confirms.
\- ETH: if a tx fails, no success modal will appear; only real mint receipts trigger it.

If you hit any further issues, send the latest tx hashes, and I’ll inspect immediately.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports deploying target-specific gating fixes so only a matching confirmed mint receipt can trigger the success modal, while referral input, approval alone, and failed ETH transactions cannot.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Done! updated the mint success modal + removed the unnecessary “Finalize random referral” prompt

**No referral code mint:**
\- The “Mint successful” modal now shows only after the random commission + ticket have actually been sent (i.e., after the random-referral finalization tx confirms).

\- Copy now reads: “No referral code used. $5 commission + $500 prize draw ticket has gone to a ***My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal*** NFT holder at random.”

**Referral code mint:**
\- The “Mint successful” modal copy now reads: “$5 commission + $500 prize draw ticket has gone to your chosen ***My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal*** NFT holder.”

\- Fallback (only if needed):
If the finalized tx is rejected/failed, the modal will show a small retry section (and the main copy will not claim the reward “has gone” yet).

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports implementing separate referral and no-referral success messages, delaying no-referral success until random reward finalization confirms, and avoiding a completed-reward claim when finalization fails.
